caption:
Instagram will now dub your Reels into other languages with AI — currently English, Spanish, Portuguese and Hindi. Mosseri has called translations out directly as a tactic for boosting reach, because more people can understand and engage with the content.

Sit with that for a second. The ceiling on most accounts is not the quality of the work. It's that it only speaks to one language group, and the recommendation system has nobody else to show it to.

Four languages is not a small lever. Spanish and Portuguese alone open two of the biggest Instagram populations on earth, and you don't make anything new — it's the same video.

One practical detail most people miss: scheduling helps here. Mosseri pointed out that scheduling gives Instagram time to process the translations, so every language version is ready the moment the post goes live. Posting manually at the last second means the translations may not be done.

Schedule it, turn translation on, and let one video do four jobs.
